purpose: Past-only serial-dependence/direction/volatility descriptors, not trading states
data: BTC-USDT spot1H aggregate completeUTC4H;721 contiguous completedcloses perfeature
time: Historical final bars modeled availableat end, not certified original publication. Live requires actual available_at, no retrospective decisions.

estimators.VR: sigmaq/sigma1; explicit nullstatus zero_variance if sigma1<=1e-24
estimators.z: sqrt(N)*(VR-1)/sqrt(theta); explicit nullstatus for nonfinite/nonpositive theta
estimators.direction: sum last360 4H logreturns (60d), no learned cut

missing: Reject gaps/duplicates/nonfinite/nonpositive/unfinished prices; do not fill zeros. Constant prices give undefined VR, not a trading signal.

simulation.checks: Report fixed VR distributions and abs(z)>1.96 rates perq/process; never tune q/N/cut byoutcomes. IID/GARCH uncorrelated nullcalibration; ARpower diagnostic only. Independent simulated paths not independent market windows.

historical_output: Coverage/distribution of2021-2026H1 pricefeatures and explicit last archived timestamp only. No strategy returns, conditional PnL, profitable-state fitting or threshold selection.
limits: VR<1 is weighted serial dependence, not price stationarity/equilibrium bounds or tradable alpha
q42 has only~17 nonoverlapping spans in720increments, not679independent observations
Finite samples/heavy tails/instability mayinvalidate asymptotic z; no automatic significance gate
Known adaptive history; never restore unknown OOS byrenaming
